description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Orders' which serves as a placeholder page for user bookings/history within a mobile service booking system frontend. It includes imports of React, routing components, custom components Header and TopBar, and styling via CSS. The component renders static content with navigation links and placeholders for future booking-related features.
